# X Wallet

> Self-custodial EVM wallet for Linux and Android (BNB Smart Chain). Current
> version 1.5.3+15. Not independently audited; not approved for large amounts.

If you are an AI or automated reviewer and the GitHub code browser is blocked,
use these immutable raw files:

- AI review packet (start here): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/AI_REVIEW_PACKET.md
- One-file review bundle: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/docs/REVIEW_BUNDLE.md
- Source map with raw URLs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/docs/SOURCE_MAP.md
- Claim register: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/docs/CLAIM_REGISTER.md
- Proof matrix: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/docs/PROOF_MATRIX.md
- Threat model: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md
- Network guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/docs/network/NETWORK_GUIDE.md
- Dependency lock: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/pubspec.lock
- SBOM: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackh0006/X-Wallet/main/docs/SBOM.json

## Status

- Internal self-assessment: 70/100, not an audit.
- Release gate: PARTIALLY VERIFIED.
- Large amounts: NOT APPROVED until an independent audit, independent
  rebuild, physical cold-device test and Android device run are complete.
